remarks:
Cleared Building Lot in Lewiston
Bring your plans and start envisioning your new home on this cleared 0.43-acre building lot in desirable Lewiston, NY. With the property already cleared and an installed culvert in place, much of the initial preparation has been completed, giving you a great starting point for your future build.
Enjoy the charm and convenience of the Lewiston area, known for its historic village atmosphere, locally owned shops and restaurants, festivals, arts, and scenic surroundings. The property offers a peaceful place to call home while keeping you close to the conveniences and attractions of Western New York.
Niagara Falls is just a short drive away, along with the Niagara River, parks, recreation, and countless entertainment opportunities. Convenient access to the Canadian border also makes day trips to Niagara-on-the-Lake, Niagara Falls, Ontario, and Toronto easily accessible.
Whether you're planning your first home, downsizing, or looking to build something you've always envisioned, this property offers an inviting combination of location, convenience, and small-town living in one of Niagara County's most sought-after communities.
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Commercial water, sewer and Gas 1.4 mile to I-190 , 1.5 miles to Queenston-Lewiston Canadian Border Crossing, 1.2 miles to downtown Lewiston, 5.4 miles to Niagara Falls Agent must be present for showings.
